notes: Verified live 2026-10-07 in headed Chrome from a residential connection, read only. The home page form (#inputFirstName, #inputLastName, #inputCityState, submitted with Enter) only redirects to /people/john-smith/houston/tx, so the recipe builds that URL directly and the canary opens it, which keeps the form out of the scan. That page lists 4 people with .card-block cards: a.name-list-title (the name and the record link, a /people/<name>/<token> URL), an h2 span.h2SubTitle with "Age 62 - City, ST", a div.h2SubTitle with the previous locations, and the relatives as a.link-underline links that point at other people. The page also has .card-block elements that are ads, which have no name link and are skipped. The bare name page /people/john-smith lists 248 people nationwide in the same markup. Cloudflare answers a Playwright launched Chrome with its "Just a moment" check and let a plain Chrome through, so a worker run may end as bot_detection. The opt-out page was not re-read. The old version read selectors that matched nothing and returned no candidates.
